statBlock.name: Green Hag
statBlock.description: A swamp or woodland hag who uses false cries for help to lure travelers into danger.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. She can breathe air and water.
Mimicry. She can imitate animal sounds and humanoid voices. A listener identifies the imitation with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Charisma (spell save DC 12). She needs no material components.
At will: Dancing Lights, Minor Illusion, Vicious Mockery.
sections.Actions:
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.
Illusory Appearance. The hag disguises herself and everything she wears or carries as a creature of her general size and humanoid shape. She can end the effect with a bonus action, and it ends if she dies. Touch can reveal discrepancies between the illusion and her body. A creature can also spend an action inspecting the disguise and identify it with a successful DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check.
Invisible Passage. She becomes Invisible, as does everything she wears or carries. The effect ends when she attacks, casts a spell, or loses Concentration as if concentrating on a spell. During the effect she leaves no physical evidence of her passage. Only magic can track her.

statBlock.name: Green Hag (Coven Variant)
statBlock.description: A swamp or woodland hag who uses false cries for help to lure travelers into danger. This hag belongs to a three-member coven.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. She can breathe air and water.
Mimicry. She can imitate animal sounds and humanoid voices. A listener identifies the imitation with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Charisma (spell save DC 12). She needs no material components.
At will: Dancing Lights, Minor Illusion, Vicious Mockery.
sections.Actions:
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.
Illusory Appearance. The hag disguises herself and everything she wears or carries as a creature of her general size and humanoid shape. She can end the effect with a bonus action, and it ends if she dies. Touch can reveal discrepancies between the illusion and her body. A creature can also spend an action inspecting the disguise and identify it with a successful DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check.

sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 176–177. The coven sidebar is on p. 176.
sections.Variant rules: Green Hag (Coven) is the other library label for the same printed coven profile.
sections.Shared spellcasting:
A coven has three hags of any type. All three can use these wizard spells while they are within 30 ft. of one another. Track one pool of spell slots for the whole coven. Each hag casts as a 12th-level spellcaster using Intelligence. This hag uses spell save DC 13 and +5 to hit with spell attacks for this list.
1st level (4 slots): Identify, Ray of Sickness.
2nd level (3 slots): Hold Person, Locate Object.
3rd level (3 slots): Bestow Curse, Counterspell, Lightning Bolt.
4th level (3 slots): Phantasmal Killer, Polymorph.
5th level (2 slots): Contact Other Plane, Scrying.
6th level (1 slot): Eyebite.
sections.Hag Eye: A coven can have one Hag Eye. A coven member on the same plane can spend an action to see through it. The eye has AC 10, 1 HP, and darkvision 60 ft. If it is destroyed, each coven member takes 3d10 psychic damage and becomes Blinded for 24 hours. All three hags must perform a 1-hour ritual to make a new eye. They cannot do so while Blinded, and an action outside the ritual makes them start over.

statBlock.name: Vampire Spawn
statBlock.description: A vampire’s victim raised as a hungry undead servant. The spawn gains its freedom if its creator dies.

sections.Damage resistances: Necrotic. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Regeneration. At the start of its turn, it regains 10 HP if it has at least 1 HP and is outside sunlight and running water. Radiant damage or damage from holy water stops regeneration at the start of its next turn.
Spider Climb. It can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.
Undead Nature. It needs no air.
sections.Vampire weaknesses:
Forbiddance. An occupant must invite the spawn before it enters a residence.
Harmed by Running Water. Ending its turn in running water deals 20 acid damage to it.
Stake to the Heart. A wooden piercing weapon driven into its heart while it is Incapacitated at its resting place destroys it.
Sunlight Hypersensitivity. Starting its turn in sunlight deals 20 radiant damage to it. Sunlight imposes disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. It makes two attacks, with at most one Bite.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage. On a hit, it may Grapple the target in place of dealing damage. Escape DC 13.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature that is willing, Grappled by this spawn, Incapacitated, or Restrained. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. Reduce the target’s maximum HP and heal the spawn by the necrotic damage taken. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a Long Rest. The target dies if its maximum HP reaches 0.
sections.Creation and control: The vampire that created the spawn controls it. If that vampire willingly lets the spawn drink its blood, the spawn becomes a true Vampire and is free of that control. The spawn also becomes free-willed if its creator dies.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 295, 298 (stat block p. 298). The official errata changes the resistance wording.

statBlock.name: Vampire Spellcaster
statBlock.description: A vampire who prepares wizard spells and rests by day in a coffin, crypt, or grave.

sections.Damage resistances: Necrotic. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Shapechanger. Outside sunlight and running water, the vampire can use an action to become a Tiny bat, a Medium cloud of mist, or its true form. As a bat, it cannot speak, has a walking speed of 5 ft. and flying speed of 30 ft., and otherwise retains its stats apart from size. Worn gear transforms with it, and carried gear does not. Death returns it to true form. As mist, it cannot use actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It weighs nothing, flies 20 ft. with hover, can stop in hostile creatures' spaces, fits anywhere air can pass without squeezing, and cannot pass through water. It has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saves in mist form and is immune to nonmagical damage other than sunlight damage.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). It can turn a failed save into a success.
Misty Escape. At 0 HP outside its resting place, it becomes mist instead of falling Unconscious. It is destroyed if sunlight or running water prevents the change. At 0 HP in mist form, it cannot revert voluntarily and must reach its resting place in 2 hours or be destroyed. When it arrives, it reverts and is Paralyzed until it has at least 1 HP. An hour spent there at 0 HP restores 1 HP.
Regeneration. It regains 20 HP at the start of each turn if it has at least 1 HP and is outside sunlight and running water. Radiant damage or damage from holy water stops regeneration at the start of its next turn.
Spider Climb. It climbs difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.
Undead Nature. It needs no air. A vampire without a formal burial rests beneath a foot of soil at the place where it became undead.
sections.Vampire weaknesses:
Forbiddance. An occupant must invite the vampire before it enters a residence.
Harmed by Running Water. Ending a turn in running water deals 20 acid damage to it.
Stake to the Heart. If a wooden piercing weapon pierces its heart while it is Incapacitated at its resting place, it is Paralyzed until the weapon is removed.
Sunlight Hypersensitivity. Starting its turn in sunlight deals 20 radiant damage to it. It has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks in sunlight.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack (vampire form only). It makes two attacks, with at most one Bite.
Unarmed Strike (vampire form only). Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. It can instead Grapple the target on a hit (escape DC 18).
Bite (bat or vampire form only). Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature that is willing, Grappled by this vampire, Incapacitated, or Restrained. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. Reduce the target's maximum HP and heal the vampire by the necrotic damage taken. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a Long Rest, and the target dies if its maximum HP becomes 0. A humanoid killed this way and buried in the ground rises the next night as a Vampire Spawn under its control.
Charm. Choose one humanoid the vampire sees within 30 ft. If the target sees it, the target makes a DC 17 Wisdom save against magic. Failure leaves the target Charmed, treating the vampire as a trusted friend to protect and heed. The target interprets the vampire's actions and requests as favorably as it can and is willing to be bitten. It retains control of its own actions. Each harmful act by the vampire or its allies lets the target repeat the save, ending the effect on success. The charm ends after 24 hours, if the vampire is destroyed, if the two are on different planes, or if the vampire uses a Bonus Action to end it.
Children of the Night (1/day). If the sun is down, it magically calls 2d4 Swarms of Bats or Swarms of Rats. Outdoors it can call 3d6 Wolves instead. The creatures arrive after 1d4 rounds, ally with the vampire, and obey its spoken orders. They stay for 1 hour or until the vampire dies or dismisses them with a Bonus Action.
sections.Legendary actions:
Three legendary actions per round, spent one option at a time after another creature's turn. It regains spent actions at the start of its turn. It cannot use them while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it can use them only after its first turn.
Move. It moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
Unarmed Strike. It makes one Unarmed Strike.
Bite (2 actions). It makes one Bite attack.
sections.Regional effects: Bats, rats, and wolves grow more numerous around its lair. Within 500 ft., plants wither and grow twisted and thorny, shadows stretch and sometimes move on their own, and fog clings to the ground and occasionally takes strange shapes. The effects end 2d6 days after the vampire is destroyed.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 295–298 (base stat block p. 297, variant p. 298). The official errata corrects the spell save DC and spell attack bonus.
sections.Spellcasting:
9th-level wizard spellcaster. Intelligence (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will): Mage Hand, Prestidigitation, Ray of Frost.
1st level (4 slots): Comprehend Languages, Fog Cloud, Sleep.
2nd level (3 slots): Detect Thoughts, Gust of Wind, Mirror Image.
3rd level (3 slots): Animate Dead, Bestow Curse, Nondetection.
4th level (3 slots): Blight, Greater Invisibility.
5th level (1 slot): Dominate Person.
sections.Resting places: During the day the vampire must rest in its coffin, crypt, or grave. It can move its resting place, or establish additional ones, by transporting its coffin or a substantial amount of its grave dirt.
